title: 第2358章 召集更多强者第2357章 闹个天翻地覆
content_zh:
“别想轻易逃离这里！”
血刀神王手持染血的神刀，整个人如一柄出鞘的利刃，飞速追了过去，冲在最前方，与此同时，汇聚身上的气势，与周围的天地间的力量，一刀斩了过去。
洛天神王也试图逼停牧帆和冥夜无天，在后方打出强力一掌。
火凤神皇此刻的神情还有些恍惚，都是因为被牧帆和冥夜无天所震撼，不过他还知道现在该做什么，也跟着打出了一道强大的攻击。
天煞神皇虽然实力最弱，知晓自己打出的攻击可能没什么效果，但还是得做做样子，所以也跟着使出了一招自身最强的一道攻击。
“注意后面！”冥夜无天瞥了一眼后方，提醒道。
“我来！”
牧帆转过身，深吸了一口气，身上的气势骤然飙升一大截，天地间同时响起了无数的剑鸣声，伴随着惊鸿神剑的挥舞，《剑十九》，应声斩了出去。
这一门永恒级神通，牧帆已经修炼到了大成，威力甚至比一些圆满级别的永恒级神通都要强大。
这一剑斩出，引起的能量风暴，仿佛可以掀翻整片黑域平原，相当的夸张。
“轰隆！”
恐怖的能量碰撞的声音，响彻这片黑域。
结果，牧帆凭借一己之力，硬生生挡住了四尊天地永恒境强者同时打出的攻击！
“好漂亮的一剑！”
冥夜无天以欣赏的语气，忍不住赞叹一声，“不愧是我最欣赏的对手，竟已能挥出这种级别的一剑！”
恐怖的剑气能量风暴，让四大强者的脚步，暂时止住了。
趁此机会，牧帆和冥夜无天，瞬间加速，拉开了距离。
“居然是大成的《剑十九》！”
血刀神王左臂挡在身前，挡下不断刺过来的剑气，眉头紧锁，“单论剑道造诣，放眼整个宇宙，此子也已经进前十了！”
洛天神王看着已经消失在黑暗中的牧帆和冥夜无天，气得咬牙切齿，“可恶的冥夜无天！竟敢坏我们好事！”

若非冥夜无天这个变故，洛天神王可以肯定，他们此刻估计都已经拿下牧帆了。
天煞神皇没有说话，心中却是万分无奈，“果然，即便有双神王，还有火凤神皇相助，还是没能成功，牧帆这小子，太难对付了……”
火凤神皇同样望着牧帆和冥夜无天消失的地方，久久无法回过神来，“三尊天地永恒境巅峰，外加一个天地永恒境初期，竟奈何不了两个乾坤永恒境后期……”
说出去，恐怕都没有多少人相信。
content_en:
"Don't even think about escaping from here easily!"
The Blood Sword God King held the blood-stained magic sword, and his whole body was like an unsheathed sharp blade. He quickly chased after him and rushed to the front. At the same time, he gathered the aura on his body and the power of the surrounding heaven and earth to slash through with one strike.
God King Luotian also tried to force Mu Fan and Ming Ye Wutian to stop, and struck a powerful palm from behind.
The Fire Phoenix God Emperor was still in a daze at the moment, all because he was shocked by Mu Fan and Ming Ye Wutian, but he still knew what to do now, and followed up with a powerful attack.
Although the Tiansha God Emperor was the weakest and knew that his attacks might have no effect, he still had to show off, so he followed up with his strongest attack.
"Watch the back!" Ming Ye Wutian glanced behind him and warned.
"I'll do it!"
Mu Fan turned around, took a deep breath, and his aura suddenly soared. Countless sword sounds sounded in the world at the same time. With the swing of the Jinghong Divine Sword, "Sword Nineteen" was slashed out in response.
Mu Fan has cultivated this eternal level magical power to great perfection, and its power is even more powerful than some perfect level eternal level supernatural powers.
The energy storm caused by this sword slash seemed to be able to overturn the entire black plain, which was quite exaggerated.
"Boom!"
The sound of terrifying energy collision resounded throughout this dark area.
As a result, Mu Fan relied on his own strength to block the simultaneous attacks of four powerful men in the Eternal Realm of Heaven and Earth!
"What a beautiful sword!"
Ming Ye Wutian couldn't help but admire in an appreciative tone, "As expected of my most admired opponent, he can actually swing a sword of this level!"
The terrifying sword energy storm temporarily stopped the steps of the four powerful men.
Taking this opportunity, Mu Fan and Ming Ye Wutian accelerated in an instant and distanced themselves.
"It's actually Dacheng's "Sword Nineteen"!"
The Blood Sword God King blocked his left arm in front of him to block the sword energy that kept coming, and frowned, "In terms of swordsmanship alone, if you look at the entire universe, this kid is already in the top ten!"
God King Luotian looked at Mu Fan and Ming Ye Wutian who had disappeared into the darkness, and gritted his teeth in anger, "Damn Ming Ye Wutian! How dare you ruin our good deeds!"
If it hadn't been for Ming Ye Wutian's change, Luotian Divine King could be sure that they would have captured Mu Fan by now.
The Emperor Tiansha didn't say anything, but he felt extremely helpless in his heart, "Sure enough, even with the help of the two God Kings and the Fire Phoenix God Emperor, we still couldn't succeed. This kid Mu Fan is too difficult to deal with..."
The Fire Phoenix God Emperor also looked at the place where Mu Fan and Ming Ye Wutian disappeared, unable to recover for a long time, "Three deities at the peak of the eternal realm of heaven and earth, plus one in the early stage of the eternal realm of heaven and earth, can't do anything to two late stages of the eternal realm of heaven and earth..."
If you tell me, not many people will believe it.
